author: Good Enough
description:
The worst punishments still used today include judicial caning, amputations, stoning, and other extreme penalties still carried out around the world. This video breaks down real punishments that are still used today, how they work, and why they still exist.

Some punishments from history were never meant to survive, but some are still used today. This video breaks down a series of real-world penalties, starting with judicial caning, where individuals are struck with a cane as a form of physical punishment. It then moves into extreme sensory deprivation with Iran’s all-white isolation cells, designed to strip away stimulation and disorient the mind. In some regions, amputations are still carried out as punishment for certain crimes, followed by chemical and surgical castration, which aim to suppress or permanently eliminate libido. title: The Worst Punishments Still Used Today
